plainText:
Akiko Hiramatsu (Japanese: 平松晶子 Hiramatsu Akiko) is a Japanese voice actress for . 

==Biography==
Hiramatsu was born on August 31, 1967 in , , and became a voice actress as an adult. Hiramatsu did minor work for , voicing characters of the day as well as characters. Her most famous role was providing the voice of Jessie when her usual voice actress, Megumi Hayashibara, went on maternity leave. She is currently working for Ken Production, a Japanese voice actor management agency.
